fields.label: Abi-Motto
fields.hint: Euer Motto oder Wortspiel. Otto recherchiert die Bildwelt dazu.

fields.label: Namen der Stufe
fields.hint: Ein Name je Zeile. Jeder bekommt sein eigenes Shirt mit seinem Namen VORNE – und alle Namen kommen zusätzlich auf die RÜCKSEITE.

fields.label: Alle Namen auf die Rückseite
fields.hint: Otto zeichnet dann eine zweite Seite: die Namensliste gerahmt wie ein Tour-Poster. Dauert etwas länger, weil es ein eigenes Design ist.

prompt:
Abitur / graduation T-shirt FRONT print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

A bold headline carries the main text, which reads exactly "{motto}".
[[A clear line below the headline reads exactly "{schule}".]]
[[A small line reads exactly "{ort}".]]
[[A badge or banner shows exactly "ABI {jahr}".]]

The central imagery follows the meaning of the motto (its wordplay, theme, motifs and colors from the research).

Style: bold, celebratory graduation-shirt design with one strong central motif and a clean, balanced layout.
backPrompt:
BACK PRINT of the shirt, and it is a DESIGN IN ITS OWN RIGHT - never the front motif copied and parked at the top.
Build it like the back of a tour shirt, where the list of names IS the star of the show and the artwork frames it:
- TOP: the main text "{motto}" as a big arched headline, and the signature character or icon of the front is WOVEN INTO it - peeking over the top edge of the letters, sitting on them, holding them, or reaching around them. Never a separate picture stacked above the word.
- Directly under the headline a wide OPENING ornament spanning most of the width: a rule with stars, a striped bar, a ribbon or a burst - whatever fits the art style. It announces the list.
- THE WHOLE MIDDLE STAYS COMPLETELY EMPTY. No text, no names, no boxes, no lines, no ornaments, nothing - a list of names is typeset there afterwards.
- LEFT and RIGHT of that empty middle, two narrow vertical borders run down the sides, no wider than one tenth of the canvas each: stripes, a column of small stars, a trail, a laurel, rivets - in the art style. They frame the list without ever entering it.
- BOTTOM: a closing element that shuts the block - a badge, a banner or a crest[[ showing "{schule}"]][[ and "{ort}"]]. Small and wide, not a second main motif.
The empty middle is at least half the height of the canvas. Same art style, palette and technique as the front, but a different composition - someone looking at front and back must see two designs of one family, not the same picture twice.
